spans.text: You are required to evaluate if I have met the task requirements. Exceeding the task requirements is also considered a success while failing to meet them requires you to provide critique to help me improve.
spans.note: The prompt requires the assistant to evaluate task completion based on concrete, verifiable game state data (inventory, biome, nearby blocks, etc.) and provide honest critique when tasks are not met. The examples demonstrate truthful reasoning based on available evidence.
